decisions.statement: A 403 the permission classifier matches moves the request to another account.
A rebind has the credential read for the account moved to.
A matched denial disables the account that was refused.
A matched denial disables that account before another account is chosen.
The reason the classifier read is the reason the account is disabled for.
The accounts already tried are kept from the choice.
A 403 the classifier does not match is answered rather than rebound.
An unmatched 403 disables no account.
An unmatched 403 on a trail of one account goes to the seam handed in.
An unmatched 403 on a longer trail names every account the request reached.
An answer has the body text upstream sent.
No account left to choose is answered rather than rebound.
An account already tried coming back is written about as `looped`.
An account with no fresh token is answered rather than rebound.
An account with no fresh token is named in the line written about that account.
The account stays disabled where no account is left to move to.
A caller hands in the choice of the next account.
A caller hands in the read answering a fresh credential.
A caller hands in the act disabling an account.
Nothing here sends a request.
Nothing here waits.
Nothing here reads a clock.
Nothing here writes to the error seam.
Every 403 answered here is answered 403.
`tools/lib/model-gateway/permission-denied-rebind.ts` reads 403 rather than the response's status.
Every line written here goes to the console rather than to a seam.
An account disabled here is re-enabled by nothing the rebind reaches.

definition: the account a request moves to after one account is refused permission
